annotations.title: File a feature or data request

description: File a feature request or data request for the user, after telling them their question isn't covered and they agree. kind "data" is missing coverage (a game, format, stack depth, spot, or solve); kind "feature" is a missing capability (a tool, filter, export, or endpoint). Free with any key; the PokerData team reads every one.

details.description: Anything else that helps: game, format, stakes, stack depths, positions, how they would use it.

kind.description: "data" for missing coverage, "feature" for a missing capability.

question.description: The user's original question that couldn't be answered, verbatim if possible.

summary.description: One line saying what the user wants, e.g. "9-max MTT preflop at 25bb with ICM".

name: submit_request

message.description: What happens next, to relay to the user.

question.description: The question that couldn't be answered, or null.

title: File a feature or data request
